title: The one-line rule for tracking turns says a turn that pushes still ends with the report
why: Incident (shiv, Nov 1 16:18 and 16:20 CST, in chat to triage): the report guard's second message keeps coming back on his screen, despite #125 (Sep 23), #669 (c101, Oct 27) and #706 (c133, Oct 27). Triage hit it three times on Nov 1 after one-line replies to roadmap status pushes. He ruled (16:23 CST, question box) that 'every turn that pushes ends with the report' is already how things work, not a change.
note: Cause: two rules clash. output-styles/shiv-stylisms.md rule output-tracking-turn-one-line says a turn that only tracks running work gets one line or none; the report guard (lint/report_guard.py LANDING_TOOLS, which includes mcp__github__push_files) and rule reports-no-report-when-nothing-landed demand the report on any turn that pushes. A session that follows the first rule on a status push is blocked by the second, and the report arrives as a second message. Fix the text, not the guard: rule output-tracking-turn-one-line gains 'A turn that pushes is not a tracking turn: it ends with the report.' Record-writer and reviewer land it. Done check: the style line is on main, ste-lint passes, and the rule's entry in lint/rule_mechanisms.json names the report guard as its check for the push case. Needs no answer.
